scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
恭喜。
向戰士們致敬！

[武術宗師]
技巧。
速度。
力量。
敏捷。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
A Champion can
benefit from all
these things. But
one can only master
so much in life...
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
這些都能讓武術宗師受益。
但人的一生，能精通的東西終究有限...

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It's time.
Time for great heroes
to stand up against the
forces of evil which plague
the world of Midgard!
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
時機已到。
偉大的英雄們，是時候挺身而出，對抗肆虐米德加爾特的邪惡勢力了！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Would you like
to become a Champion?
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
你願意成為武術宗師嗎？

scripts.text:
[Champion]
When you're ready,
feel free to come back.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
準備好了，隨時回來吧。
向戰士們致敬！

scripts.text:
[Champion]
It is still possible for you to learn more skills. Please use
all of your remaining Skill Points before returning to me.
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
你還有可以學習的技能。
請用完剩餘的技能點，再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Congratulations!
Live as a Champion,
and bring light into
the world through the
strength of your fists.
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
恭喜！
以武術宗師的身份，用雙拳的力量為世界帶來光明吧。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Welcome
to Valhalla,
the Hall of Honor.
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
歡迎來到榮耀之廳——英靈殿。

scripts.text:
[Champion]
Please make
yourself comfortable
while you are here.
Honor to the warriors!
scripts.translation:
[武術宗師]
在這裡安心休息吧。
向戰士們致敬！
